channel.description: Newest perfume decant arrivals at Decantified

item.title: Hawas Crystelle by Rasasi – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rasasi
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Hawas Crystelle is a bright, polished Eau de Parfum from Rasasi's Hawas line, built around the sparkle of crystal. Bergamot, grapefruit and elemi open fresh and zesty before pepper, lavender, saffron and cedarwood bring aromatic warmth to the heart. It dries down creamy and smooth on vanilla, tonka bean, musk and vetiver, easy enough for every day and warm enough for evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Elemi
Middle: Pepper, Lavender, Saffron, Cedarwood
Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: office, date night, night out · Time: day and night

item.title: Hawas Blanche by Rasasi – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rasasi
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Hawas Blanche is the Hawas character rewritten clean and contemporary: an Eau de Parfum from Rasasi that opens on tart blackcurrant, crisp apple and sparkling citrus. A green, herbal heart of wormwood, basil and geranium leads into a dry, mossy base of sandalwood and musk. Fresh but with real depth, it moves easily from daytime into the evening.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Black Currant, Apple, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot
Middle: Wormwood, Geranium, Basil, Patchouli
Base: Sandalwood, Moss, Dry Wood, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday, gym · Time: day into evening

item.title: Acqua di Gio Profondo Eau de Parfum by Giorgio Armani – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Giorgio Armani
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Acqua di Gio Profondo is Giorgio Armani's deep-sea take on the Acqua di Gio line, created by Alberto Morillas in 2020: cool marine notes and green mandarin dive into an aromatic heart of rosemary, lavender and cypress, finishing on mineral musk, patchouli and amber. It is an Eau de Parfum that smells fresh, clean and blue, ideal for warm days and the office. Hand-decanted from the original bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sea Notes, Aquozone, Bergamot, Green Mandarin
Middle: Rosemary, Lavender, Cypress, Mastic
Base: Mineral Notes, Musk, Patchouli, Amber

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Performance: moderate longevity and projection

item.title: Le Beau Paradise Garden by Jean Paul Gaultier – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Jean Paul Gaultier
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Le Beau Paradise Garden is a lush green-coconut Eau de Parfum by perfumer Quentin Bisch, a tropical flanker in the Le Beau line. Green notes, watery accords, mint and ginger open fresh and bright before a creamy heart of coconut, fig and a pinch of salt. Tonka bean and sandalwood give it a smooth, sweet-woody dry-down that feels like a sunlit holiday, a compliment-getter for warm days and summer nights.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Green Notes, Watery Notes, Mint, Ginger
Middle: Coconut, Fig, Salt
Base: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: date night, nights out, day and night

item.title: Paradoxe Eau de Parfum by Prada – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Prada
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is Prada's luminous signature for women: juicy pear, tangerine and bergamot open onto a radiant heart of neroli, orange blossom and jasmine sambac, wrapped in a soft amber, Bourbon vanilla and white musk base. It is an Eau de Parfum that feels fresh and polished yet warm and addictive up close. Hand-decanted from the original bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pear, Tangerine, Bergamot
Middle: Orange Blossom, Neroli Essence, Neroli, Jasmine Sambac
Base: Bourbon Vanilla, Amber, White Musk, Benzoin

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night, special occasions · Performance: moderate longevity, soft-to-moderate projection

item.title: Forever Wanted Elixir by Azzaro – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Azzaro
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Forever Wanted Elixir is a bold leather Eau de Parfum and the most intense take on the Wanted line. Juicy raspberry, green mandarin and bergamot open over an aromatic heart of lavender, clary sage and cardamom. It dries down to a smoky, slightly animalic leather with earthy vetiver and resinous woods, with no vanilla sweetness, for a darker, more grown-up evening signature.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Raspberry, Green Mandarin, Bergamot
Middle: Lavender, Clary Sage, Cardamom
Base: Leather, Wolfwood, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out, evenings · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Y Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Yves Saint Laurent
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Y Eau de Parfum is Yves Saint Laurent's modern classic for men: crisp apple, ginger and bergamot over an aromatic heart of sage, juniper and geranium, settling into warm amberwood, tonka and cedar. It is an Eau de Parfum that works almost anywhere, fresh by day and smooth enough for the evening. Hand-decanted from the original bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Apple, Ginger, Bergamot
Middle: Sage, Juniper Berries, Geranium
Base: Amberwood, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Vetiver, Olibanum

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: office, date night, nights out · Performance: good longevity, moderate-to-strong projection

item.title: Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Essential Parfums
Type:
Price: 4.49 - 29.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Bois Impérial is a fresh, spicy woody Eau de Parfum by perfumer Quentin Bisch, built around a smoky-clean core of akigalawood and Haitian vetiver. Thai basil and Timut pepper give it a bright, green, almost citrusy lift, while patchouli and ambery woods keep it warm and polished. It is a versatile, modern woods scent that is easy to wear year-round, unisex and at home from the office to an evening out.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Thai Basil, Timut Pepper
Middle: Haitian Vetiver, Petalia
Base: Akigalawood, Patchouli, Ambrofix

Best for

Season: Year-round – spring, summer, fall and winter · Wear it: office, date night, day and night

item.title: MYSLF Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent – Sample Decant
item.description:

Type:

Overview

MYSLF Eau de Parfum is the original MYSLF from Yves Saint Laurent: a bright, modern take on a man's floral, with sparkling Calabrian bergamot over a heart of Tunisian orange blossom, drying down to clean woods and patchouli. It is an Eau de Parfum built for everyday wear, fresh enough for the office and smooth enough for an evening out. Hand-decanted from the original bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Calabrian Bergamot, Bergamot
Middle: Tunisian Orange Blossom
Base: Ambrofix, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday, date night · Performance: moderate, close-to-medium projection

item.title: NonStop by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Bujairami
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (6 variants)

Overview

NonStop is a bright, green-aromatic Extrait de Parfum often compared to Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill. Cool mint and green lemon open over juicy blackcurrant and orange, a soft heart of apricot, basil and May rose keeps it fresh and fruity, and fig, dates, moss and ambergris give it a smooth, slightly sweet dry-down. Unisex, easy to wear and built for warm days. Composed by Adam Bujairami.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mint, Orange, Lemon, Black Currant
Middle: Basil, Apricot, May Rose
Base: Ambergris, Fig, Oakmoss, Dates

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday, gym · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Risala For You by Le Falconé – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Le Falconé
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Risala For You is a sweet, powdery floral Eau de Parfum from Le Falconé's Niche Collection, released in 2025 in a fountain-pen bottle. Neroli, honeysuckle and orange blossom open bright over pink pepper and coriander, before a soft heart of iris, jasmine, rose and marshmallow. The drydown is caramel, vanilla, sugar, labdanum and musk, a soft sugary floral often compared to Kilian Love, Don't Be Shy.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Honeysuckle, Orange Blossom, Coriander, Pink Pepper, Neroli
Middle: Iris, Jasmine, Marshmallow, Rose
Base: Musk, Labdanum, Vanilla, Caramel, Sugar

Best for

Season: Spring and fall · Wear it: date night, nights out

item.title: Cedrat Boise by Mancera – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Mancera
Type:
Price: 3.49 - 22.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Cedrat Boise is a citrus-woody Eau de Parfum from Mancera, created by Pierre Montale in 2011 for women and men. Sicilian lemon, bergamot and black currant open bright and juicy with a touch of spice, then a fruity heart of patchouli leaf and water jasmine leads into cedar, leather, sandalwood, vanilla, white musk and moss. It is a versatile, long-wearing signature that works almost anywhere.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sicilian Lemon, Bergamot, Black Currant, Spicy Notes
Middle: Fruity Notes, Patchouli Leaf, Water Jasmine
Base: Cedar, Leather, Sandalwood, Vanilla, White Musk, Moss

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday, date night · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Black Sea by Lorenzo Pazzaglia – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Lorenzo Pazzaglia
Type:
Price: 7.49 - 44.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Black Sea is a salty, marine Extrait de Parfum created by Lorenzo Pazzaglia in 2019 for women and men. Ozonic sea air, salt and myrtle open over a flash of bergamot, then ylang-ylang and orange blossom bring a sunlit softness to the heart. The base settles into ambergris, algae, oakmoss, patchouli and white musk, a strong, mineral take on the sea that wears loud and lasts.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Salt, Ozonic Notes, Watery Notes, Myrtle, Bergamot
Middle: Sea Notes, Salt, Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom
Base: Ambergris, Algae, White Musk, Oakmoss, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: everyday, gym, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.description:

Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

O'Clock is a bold apple-and-leather oriental from Ahmed Al Maghribi, made as an Eau de Parfum. Crisp apple, lavender, grapefruit and a pinch of cinnamon lead into orange blossom, lily of the valley and soft leather. It settles into a warm, sweet base of vanilla, amber, musk and patchouli, often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Apple, Lavender, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Cinnamon
Middle: Leather, Lily of the Valley, Orange Blossom
Base: Vanilla, Musk, Patchouli, Amber

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: strong projection in the first hours

item.title: Endless by Ahmed Al Maghribi – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Ahmed Al Maghribi
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Endless is a soft fruity-floral Eau de Parfum from Ahmed Al Maghribi. Juicy peach and apple blossom open onto a rose and pineapple-blossom heart, drying down to clean musk, creamy sandalwood and a touch of patchouli. Easy, polished and genuinely unisex, it works from morning meetings to relaxed evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Apple Blossom, Peach
Middle: Rose, Pineapple Blossom
Base: Musk, Sandalwood, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday · Performance: moderate, close to the skin after a few hours

item.title: Black Fume by Ahmed Al Maghribi – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Ahmed Al Maghribi
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Black Fume is a dark, smoky oriental from Ahmed Al Maghribi, made as an Extrait de Parfum. Jammy raspberry opens over burnt woods and powdery orris, then settles into a resinous base of labdanum, oud, tobacco and ambroxan. It is a dense, statement scent with a smoky trail, often compared to Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade. A light hand goes a long way.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Raspberry
Middle: Woody Notes, Orris
Base: Oud, Labdanum, Tobacco, Ambroxan

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.title: Khair Felicity by Paris Corner – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Paris Corner
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Khair Felicity is a sparkling, soft floral-musk Eau de Parfum from Paris Corner's Khair line, built around a fizzy champagne opening. Cassis and freesia keep the top bright and airy before jasmine and May rose settle into a clean, powdery musk heart. The dry-down is a sugared vanilla and musk skin scent with a romantic, polished feel inspired by Kayali The Wedding Silk Santal 36.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Champagne, Freesia, Cassis
Middle: Musk, Jasmine, May Rose
Base: Sugar, Vanilla, Musk

Best for

Season: Year-round · Wear it: office, date night, special occasions · Performance: soft, close to the skin

item.title: Khair by Paris Corner – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Paris Corner
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Khair is a fresh, aromatic oud Eau de Parfum from Paris Corner, the scent that started the Khair line. Davana, bergamot and pink pepper open bright and herbal before rosemary, amber and agarwood bring in a clean, green oud heart. Leather, vetiver and musk give it a dry, refined finish in a fresh-oud style often compared to Gissah Imperial Valley.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Davana, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Agarwood, Oud, Amber, Rosemary
Base: Leather, Vetiver, Musk

Best for

Season: Year-round · Wear it: office, nights out, day or night

item.title: Banadir 113 by Banadir Fragrance – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Banadir Fragrance
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Banadir 113 by Banadir Fragrance is a clean, green herbal scent: bright bergamot and crushed aromatic herbs over a soft veil of orange blossom and white musk. It is an Extrait de Parfum, giving a cologne-style freshness extra depth and wear time. Banadir 113 is a polished, spa-fresh everyday scent inspired by Guerlain Herbes Troublantes.

The dry-down is soapy-clean and gently powdery, with white musk keeping it close, elegant and easy to wear anywhere.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Herbal Notes
Middle: Orange Blossom
Base: White Musk

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Time: daytime

item.title: Banadir 94 by Banadir Fragrance – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Banadir Fragrance
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Banadir 94 by Banadir Fragrance is a rich, smoky woody-spicy scent that opens on saffron, cardamom, cypress and a bitter green bite of artemisia, then deepens into rose, oud and soft leather. It is an Extrait de Parfum, made for cooler evenings and lasting wear. Banadir 94 is a refined, statement oud-leather inspired by Penhaligon's Halfeti.

The base is warm and resinous, with cedar, sandalwood, amber, tonka and vanilla smoothing the leather and oud into a plush, lingering trail.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cypress Leaf, Saffron, Cardamom, Artemisia, Bergamot, Grapefruit
Middle: Bulgarian Rose, Nutmeg, Jasmine
Base: Agarwood (Oud), Cedar, Leather, Sandalwood, Amber, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Musk

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasion · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Banadir 92 by Banadir Fragrance – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Banadir Fragrance
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Banadir 92 by Banadir Fragrance is a sunny, easygoing citrus-musk scent built on sparkling mandarin and juicy pear over a soft, slightly powdery musk. It is an Extrait de Parfum, so the light, breezy character gets a little more weight and longevity. Banadir 92 is a relaxed warm-weather favourite inspired by Louis Vuitton California Dream.

As it settles, ambrette and benzoin add a smooth, gently sweet warmth that keeps the musk close and comfortable.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mandarin Orange, Pear
Middle: Ambrette (Musk Mallow)
Base: Benzoin, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Time: daytime

item.title: Banadir 89 by Banadir Fragrance – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Banadir Fragrance
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Banadir 89 by Banadir Fragrance is a crisp, sparkling citrus-aromatic scent that opens on lemon, cool mint and grapefruit, then moves into lavender, rosemary and geranium over clean ambery woods. It is an Extrait de Parfum, giving a fresh profile more body and staying power. Banadir 89 is an easy, versatile everyday scent inspired by Parfums de Marly Sedley.

The dry-down is smooth and clean, with ambroxan, sandalwood, cedar and cashmeran giving a soft, skin-like woody finish.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lemon, Mint, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Mandarin Orange
Middle: Lavender, Rosemary, Geranium, Olibanum
Base: Ambroxan, Sandalwood, Cedar, Cashmeran, Vetiver, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Time: daytime

item.title: Banadir 01 by Banadir Fragrance – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Banadir Fragrance
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Banadir 01 by Banadir Fragrance is a bright, juicy fruity-spicy scent that opens on pineapple, blackcurrant and grapefruit before settling into warm ginger, cinnamon and mossy woods. It is an Extrait de Parfum, so it wears richer and longer than a typical fresh fragrance. Banadir 01 is a confident, compliment-friendly signature inspired by Creed Absolu Aventus.

The dry-down turns smooth and woody, with patchouli, vetiver, oakmoss, sandalwood and a soft tonka-musk warmth that keeps the fruit from ever feeling thin.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Black Currant, Pineapple, Nutmeg, Cloves
Middle: Ginger, Cinnamon, Citron, Cardamom, Rose
Base: Patchouli, Vetiver, Oakmoss, Ambroxan, Sandalwood, Musk, Tonka, Evernyl

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night, special occasion · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Vibrato by Sospiro Perfumes – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Sospiro Perfumes
Type:
Price: 6.49 - 44.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Vibrato is a bright, polished unisex Eau de Parfum: sparkling grapefruit and bergamot lifted by jasmine and magnolia, settling into fresh ginger, green herbs and a soft powdery heart. The dry-down is clean and refined, with musk, cedar, amber, patchouli and orris giving it an elegant, slightly creamy finish.

Composed by Christian Provenzano and launched in 2022, it is the genuine original from the Sospiro Collection, and the fragrance a whole wave of citrus-and-ginger tributes is built around. Try the real thing in a 1ml sample before committing to a full bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Jasmine, Magnolia
Middle: Ginger, Herbal Notes, Powdery Notes
Base: Musk, Cedar, Amber, Patchouli, Orris Root

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and early fall · Wear it: office, everyday · For: men and women

item.title: Club de Nuit Intenso Fuego by Armaf – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 62.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Club de Nuit Intenso Fuego is a 2026 Eau de Parfum from Armaf's Club de Nuit line, built around a fire-and-flamenco theme. It opens bright and juicy with mandarin, grapefruit, black currant, plum and a charred pineapple accord sharpened by pink pepper, then turns aromatic with lavender, geranium and a sunny floral heart.

The drydown warms into honey, tonka, vanilla and cedar over clean white musk, so it moves from fresh and fruity to sweet and woody as it wears.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mandarin, Black Currant, Bergamot, Plum, Grapefruit, Pink Pepper, Terebinth, Charred Pineapple
Middle: Lavender, Geranium, Solar Flowers
Base: Cedar, Vanilla, Patchouli, White Musk, Ambrettolide, Honey, Tonka Bean

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: everyday, nights out · Time: day and night
